title: UCL public building and facilities directory
scope: Public UCL-listed buildings and facilities, with broad Bloomsbury/Fitzrovia coverage, both UCL East campus buildings and a supplemental satellite estate directory. Not an exhaustive property register.

provenance.method: Manually reviewed factual extraction from current public UCL Estates, library, faculty and accommodation pages. No login-only register used.
limitations: The public Estates list establishes UCL association, not freehold ownership or exclusive occupation.
Generic postal addresses do not identify a footprint or entrance.
Coordinates are null unless explicitly published by a reviewed official source; footprint representative points are maintained separately.
The complete UCL property register requires authenticated MyCampus access and was not used.
Temporary facilities and conflicting source addresses are explicitly flagged.
provenance.officialIds: Building numbers in square brackets are transcribed from the UCL Estates inclusive facilities list (updated August 2026). A group may contain several official numbers; single officialBuildingId is null in that case.
provenance.geometryPolicy: Membership is independent of a matched footprint. Shared sites and partial occupation must retain that qualification when selected or highlighted. A match never establishes ownership.
